sources.description: Register TEST (1, variant 2). VALUE (var 5) is documented in 2018 as integer and, spelled 'value', in 2022 as decimal; PAIR (var 6) in 2018 as integer and in 2022 as decimal. EDITION (var 99) delivers 2020, so a 2020 edition exists that neither column is delivered in. VALUE's entry curates data_type text (the former CIS2004 smallint + CIS2012 varchar storage, widened); PAIR's curates none. Registerinformation rows and storage rows delivered in reverse (each storage row keeps its ordinal_position).
